en.headline: Mark Six estimated jackpot rises to HK$73 million for tonight's draw
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club raised the snowball after turnover hit the first threshold, with sales closing at 9.15pm and the draw at 9.30pm.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club said the estimated first-division prize for tonight’s Lucky Tuesday Snowball Mark Six draw has been lifted to HK$73 million for a single HK$10 unit after cumulative betting turnover reached the first progressive threshold under a new campaign.

Under the “Hype Up. Jackpot Up.” mechanism introduced for the lottery’s 50th anniversary, the snowball amount is adjusted according to turnover recorded by 2pm the day before the draw. With turnover between HK$60 million and HK$70 million, the snowball rose to HK$55 million and the estimated top prize to HK$73 million. Higher turnover would have pushed the estimated prize further.

Ticket sales for draw 26/124 close at 9.15pm this evening, ahead of the live draw at 9.30pm. The Jockey Club said all tickets already purchased remain valid and updated prize figures are displayed across official channels.
The draw is the second Lucky Tuesday Snowball held this year. No first-division winner was recorded in the previous draw on 19 November.

zh.headline: 六合彩今晚金多寶估計頭獎升至7300萬元
zh.dek: 馬會因投注額達到首個門檻而提升金多寶金額，今晚9時15分截止售票，9時30分攪珠。
body: 香港賽馬會表示，今晚幸運二金多寶六合彩第26/124期的估計頭獎基金已提升至7300萬元（每注10元獨中），原因是累積投注額達到新機制的首個門檻。
「集氣加碼 頭獎升呢」活動為慶祝六合彩 50周年而設，馬會會根據攪珠前一天中午2時錄得的累積投注額調整金多寶金額。投注額介乎6000萬至7000萬元之間時，金多寶提升至5500萬元，估計頭獎相應升至7300萬元。
今期售票將於今晚9時15分截止，攪珠時間為晚上9時30分。馬會指已購買的彩票仍然有效，最新獎金額可於各官方渠道查閱。
今次是今年第二次舉辦幸運二金多寶。11月19日的上一期攪珠並無頭獎得主。
